entries.title: The Control-key preset comes to Linux
entries.body: On Linux, Settings, Keyboard now offers the preset built on Control and Alt keys, with keys made for Linux. While you type a message, Ctrl+X, Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V cut, copy and paste as in every other app; anywhere else, Ctrl+X starts a second key and Ctrl+V moves down a page. Ctrl+G cancels and leaves a message, Alt+X searches commands, and Ctrl+K deletes to the end of the line in a message.
